comparison.objective: Dial and open a hanging combination padlock; candidate separates a mixed industrial load through a sieve.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential dial rotation with rim regrasping on a swinging body, followed by shackle pull, versus bimanual load sharing and controlled sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel gates set, shackle open on hasp, lock released and still versus recovered media, retained washers, reseated screen, clear hands, and continuous dwell.
comparison.reason: Stateful dial manipulation and bulk physical screening have no meaningful task-level overlap beyond generic grasping. Missing rubric details: none material.
